I have recently been loving this track by Justin Bieber, Diplo & Skrilex so I had to cover it! Huge thanks to Satya Valli for being amazing and dancing his heart out for the video. Also to Shankar Tucker, as always, for doing the audio & video production! I also collaborated with The Peach Project on the outfit, so check them out too! And yes, I am singing Tamil words while the beat drops. I know its distorted, but can anyone guess what I'm saying?
